description: WRITE tool — switch the review responder on/off for an own iOS app and update its instructions or auto-mode policy (partial update; omitted fields keep their value). Turning auto mode on only affects reviews written afterwards; anything the AI flags as needing a human is held. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of one of your own iOS apps (an `id` from sonar_list_apps). NOT a store id.

auto_daily_cap.description: Auto mode: max auto replies per app per day (default 50).

auto_max_rating.description: Auto mode: highest star rating to auto-reply to (default 5).

auto_min_rating.description: Auto mode: lowest star rating to auto-reply to (default 4).

enabled.description: Switch the responder on (starts the review backfill) or off.

instructions.description: Instructions for the AI: tone, support contact, product facts, known issues and fixes.

mode.description: manual = every reply waits for approval; auto = AI replies post automatically after auto_delay_minutes.

reply_language.description: review = reply in the reviewer's language (default); en = always English.

sign_off.description: Sign-off appended to every reply (null clears it).

name: sonar_set_review_responder
title: Configure Review Responder
